messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created (INC-1999) — elevated 5xx rates observed from gateway -> model-serving paths, auto-alert triggered. Root sensor: kv read miss ratio spike on prefix-shard-42.

marta (SRE): seeing the alert — graph: 5xx up from 0.3% -> 8% over last 6m. Latency p95 spiked. Which customers are hitting this?

ops_analyst: quick query -> top callers are two internal prod routes + a few customer tenants in eu-west. customers affected: cust-acme, cust-nimbus (partial). No PII exposed confirmed.

cheng (runtime): digging into runtime logs now. I can repro increased backend RTTs when prefix cache miss rate crosses ~70%. Looks like a sudden prefetching gap + concurrent cold reads.

eli (platform): any config changes in deploys in last hour?

jordan (ml-infra): no deploys. I checked autoscaler events — no large scale resizes. I ran a quick grep on the kv nodes: `grep -i "evict" /var/log/kvsvc/*.log | tail -n 50` — seeing a lot of TTL-driven evictions on shard-42 and a burst of prefetch requests.

marta (SRE): can we know if the prefix keyspace had an integrity issue or just thrash?

cheng (runtime): not corruption. Checksums look ok. It's a cold-read stampede: a misbehaving downstream job rehydrated a wide set of prefixes causing eviction pressure, then normal traffic hit cold prefixes and caused synchronous loads -> heavy synchronous reads -> timeouts -> 5xx upstream.

marta (SRE): ok mitigation ideas: 1) throttle prefetch job if we can identify it, 2) increase cache capacity on affected pool, 3) enable temporary soft-fallback to read-through to slower backing store with higher concurrency limits, 4) route high-p95 traffic to spare region. Which is fastest?

eli (platform): we can bump shard-42 mem quota by 20% via the console (fast), but that takes ~2m to propagate. We can also flip a runtime flag to allow async-prefetch-on-miss instead of sync blocking reads (fast toggle).

jordan (ml-infra): async-prefetch toggle exists as `runtime.kv.async_prefetch=true` in the feature flags service. We can flip it in prod for the affected pool only. That would reduce blocking load but might slightly increase 99s for very hot prefixes temporarily.

marta (SRE): do it. Flip only for pool:gw-prod-eu-west-1. I'll prepare rollback plan.

cheng (runtime): flipping now -> `curl -s -X POST https://flags.internal/sets/kv/async_prefetch -d 'pool=gw-prod-eu-west-1&value=true'`

oncall-bot: Flag change recorded: `kv.async_prefetch` = true for pool gw-prod-eu-west-1 by cheng.

marta (SRE): watch metrics.

(30s passes)

jordan (ml-infra): immediate drop in blocking load. 5xx rate falling from 8% -> 2.1% in the first 90s. p95 latency improving.

ops_analyst: customers still seeing intermittent errors but overall success rate up to 97.8%. Impact window ~ 12m so far.

cheng (runtime): follow-up: I also pinned a few hot prefixes to a small in-memory shard cache to avoid rehydration pressure while we stabilize. Command used (internal):

```
shardctl pin --shard shard-42 --prefix "user:*/session" --ttl 5m
```

marta (SRE): good. Next step we should rate-limit the misbehaving prefetch job. Can we identify the caller?

jordan (ml-infra): querying request logs by origin -> found repeated batch job from k8s job `prefetcher-2026` (ns: batch-ops) hitting a wide keyspace at 2026-03-15T10:04:xx. That's the correlate.

eli (platform): I can patch the k8s job to add a jitter and exponential backoff, and immediately scale it to 0 for emergency. Want me to scale down?

marta (SRE): yes, scale to 0 for now. Notify the owners. We'll follow up with a controlled reconfigure.

eli (platform): scaled `prefetcher-2026` -> 0 replicas. logged action in incident ticket INC-1999.

oncall-bot: Pager duty acknowledged by marta. Handoff note set for next oncall.

marta (SRE): current status: mitigation in place (async prefetch + pinning + prefetcher scaled). 5xx ~ 0.8% and trending to baseline; customer impact reduced to minimal. Marking this incident as "mitigated - monitoring".

ops_analyst: logged customer impact summary: cust-acme experienced 32 failed requests over 12m window, cust-nimbus ~14 failures. We will offer incident summary + credits per SLA.

cheng (runtime): root cause summary (short): runaway batch prefetch job rehydrated large prefix set causing eviction pressure on shard-42 -> synchronous cold reads cascaded -> increased backend RTTs/timeouts -> upstream 5xx. Not a corruption event.

marta (SRE): immediate follow-ups: 1) postmortem runbook (owned by cheng), 2) add circuit-breaker on sync cache fills (owned by jordan), 3) alert tuning to detect prefetch bursts earlier (owned by ops_analyst).

jordan (ml-infra): I'll start a PR for circuit-breaker logic and link to INC-1999.

eli (platform): I'll follow up with prefetcher owners to change scheduling + add per-job rate limits.

marta (SRE): handoff for night oncall -> @cheng you're oncall for the rest of the window. Please watch the shard metrics and customer dashboards. If 5xx > 1.5% escalate to paging list.

cheng (runtime): ack. I'll monitor and prepare the postmortem draft.

marta (SRE): closing thread for now — keep updates here if anything regresses. Postmortem target: 48h. Thanks for quick ops. :thumbsup:
